page.layout: One column of running text, full width, from top to bottom. No margin notes, page number or running head. The catchword "pri-" stands alone at the right below the last line.

main_text.p: AMPLISSIMI, & tribus quidem verbis. Agentem apud Vos, quot mactum esse voluistis obæratumq; beneficiis? Quo me affectu, charitatibus penè orbum omnibus, in tutelam vestram recipere? Quâ saepè prosequi, si non juvare, munificentia? Quâ & privatim, atq; etiam in Amplissimo confessu Vestro, exciperehumanitate,cum-

page.notes: The first word "AMPLISSIMI" is in small capitals as printed, and the page opens mid-sentence, so the paragraph continues from the previous page. "mactum" is doubtful: the ct ligature is unclear, so it is marked as a possible misreading of the printed form. In "si non juvare" the word "si" is partly obscured by a blot, so it is uncertain. "Quâ" appears with a circumflex on a in the printed text. The catchword "pri-" is set apart at the foot.
